{"parentUuid":"07e00525-7763-4d21-ad51-508985733e66","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4dc5332e-fccd-45f6-b53b-fb048524d43a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DSvcU4U9iqq1quJDtJEt4i","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Data Bites in the admin console. Any signed-in user may do everything here,\nchart images and Site previews included, except delete, which is Director\nonly.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import chart_images, data_bites, editor, public_site\nfrom app.flash import SITE_NOTE, confirm\nfrom app.auth import current_user, require_csrf, require_director\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS, ContentError\nfrom app.rendering import images_without_description\nfrom app.routes import editing\nfrom app.routes.site_preview import site_file\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/data-bites\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n_MAX_IMAGE_MB = chart_images.MAX_BYTES // chart_images.MIB\n\n\ndef _site_preview(request: Request, form: Mapping[str, str], bite: sqlite3.Row | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to `bite` (None for a new Data\n    Bite), as HTML, served from the preview's copy of the site.\"\"\"\n    at = (request.app.url_path_for(\"bite_preview_site\", bite_id=bite[\"id\"], path=\"\")\n          if bite is not None else request.app.url_path_for(\"new_bite_preview_site\", path=\"\"))\n    return public_site.data_bite_preview(form, bite).render_preview(str(at))\n\n\ndef _images(request: Request, bite_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    return editing.image_links(request, \"serve_image\", bite_id=bite_id)\n\n\ndef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"\", \"body\": \"\"}\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], \"\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/data_bites.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Data Bites\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"bites\": data_bites.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, None),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_new_bite\")},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_bites(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _list_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_bite(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                slug: str = Form(\"\"), posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    try:\n        data_bites.create(title, slug, editor.saved_body(posted, None, None), user[\"id\"])\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _list_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, \"\", None, None))\n    confirm(request, \"Data Bite created as a Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/data-bites\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A new Data Bite's Site preview. Before the /{bite_id} routes, which would\n# otherwise take \"preview\" for an id.\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_bite(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                     posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, {\"title\": title, \"body\": shown}, None))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_bite_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Data Bite has no chart images (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\n\n\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, bite: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(bite)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"])\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/data_bite_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Data Bite\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"bite\": bite, \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"],\n                                           _images(request, bite[\"id\"]).src),\n         \"images\": list(data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"])),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, bite),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_bite\", bite_id=bite[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _get_or_404(bite_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    bite = data_bites.get(bite_id)\n    if bite is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return bite\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}\")\ndef edit_bite_form(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(bite_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_bite(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n              title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n              posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted), item_base: str = Form(\"\")):\n    bite = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\n**Charts.** A valid top-level Chart (ADR-006) is a *card*: its drawing, with\nits canonical block in `data-chart`, which the builder (T17) edits and\napp.markdown_form saves. A Chart that is invalid, or inside another block,\nis locked.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app import chart_drawing, charts\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, is_link, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\nfrom app.site_links import REFERENCE, TABLES\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return is_link(str(token.attrGet(\"href\"))) and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _chart(source: str) -> charts.Chart | None:\n    try:\n        return charts.parse(source)\n    except charts.ChartError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if len(block) == 1 and charts.is_chart(block[0]):\n        return _chart(block[0].content) is not None\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _site_link(href: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Editor shows a site link as the site reference it is, resolved or\n    not, so that it posts it back as it is and marks one that won't resolve.\"\"\"\n    return href if REFERENCE.fullmatch(href) else None\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = (render_markdown(locked[number], image_src, _site_link)\n             if number < len(locked) else \"\")\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\nCARD = \"admin-editor-chart\"\n\n\ndef _card_html(chart: charts.Chart, key: str, number: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Chart as the Editor shows it: its drawing, and its canonical block,\n    which is what the Editor posts back. Put in after nh3, like the site's\n    Charts: the drawing is safe as app.chart_drawing builds it, and the block\n    is escaped here; on save it is parsed again, never trusted.\"\"\"\n    return (f'<div class=\"{CARD}\" data-chart=\"{escape(chart.canonical())}\">'\n            f'{chart_drawing.draw(chart, key, number)}</div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`, and each valid top-level Chart as a card.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token and card is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows,\n    # so that nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    # (first line, line after the last, placeholder), each on its own.\n    spans = [(start, end, f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}\")\n             for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown)]\n    cards: list[charts.Chart] = []\n    for token in parse(markdown):\n        if (token.level == 0 and token.map and charts.is_chart(token)\n                and (chart := _chart(token.content))):\n            spans.append((*token.map, f\"chart-{nonce}-{len(cards)}\"))\n            cards.append(chart)\n    for start, end, placeholder in sorted(spans, reverse=True):\n        # A blank line either side, so a placeholder is its own paragraph\n        # (a fence may follow a paragraph's line straight on).\n        lines[start:end] = [\"\\n\", placeholder + _ending(lines[end - 1]), \"\\n\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src, _site_link))\n    # The cards' titles' ids need only be unique on the admin page.\n    key = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    return Markup(re.sub(\n        rf\"<p>(locked|chart)-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n        lambda m: (_locked_html(int(m[2]), locked, image_src) if m[1] == \"locked\"\n                   else _card_html(cards[int(m[2])], key, int(m[2]))), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, each locked block's token, and each\n# card's Chart.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"td\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"div\": {\"data-locked\", \"data-chart\"}}\n\n\n# A posted link's schemes, site links' included; app.markdown_form keeps\n# only the links the Editor may have (is_link).\n_POSTED_SCHEMES = {\"https\", \"mailto\", *TABLES}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None,\n                     url_schemes=_POSTED_SCHEMES)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\ndef canonical_charts(markdown: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each top-level Chart in it in canonical form (spec\n    #14), with the line endings of the line that closes it. A Chart that\n    breaks a rule is left as it is, for app.content.validate to name.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for token in reversed(parse(markdown)):\n        if not (charts.is_chart(token) and token.level == 0 and token.map):\n            continue\n        try:\n            chart = charts.parse(token.content)\n        except charts.ChartError:\n            continue\n        start, end = token.map\n        ending = _ending(lines[end - 1])\n        fence = f\"```{charts.INFO}\\n{chart.canonical()}```\\n\"\n        lines[start:end] = [fence.replace(\"\\n\", ending)]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return canonical_charts(self.body)\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`.    \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": status_code=303)\n\n\n# A new Data Bite's Site preview. Before the /{bite_id} routes, which would\n# otherwise take \"preview\" for an id.\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_bite(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                     posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, {\"title\": title, \"body\": shown}, None))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_bite_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Data Bite has no chart images (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\n\n\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, bite: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(bite)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"])\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/data_bite_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Data Bite\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"bite\": bite, \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"],\n                                           _images(request, bite[\"id\"]).src),\n         \"images\": list(data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"])),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, bite),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_bite\", bite_id=bite[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _get_or_404(bite_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    bite = data_bites.get(bite_id)\n    if bite is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return bite\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}\")\ndef edit_bite_form(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(bite_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_bite(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n              title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n              posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted), item_base: str = Form(\"\")):\n    bite = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\n**Charts.** A valid top-level Chart (ADR-006) is a *card*: its drawing, with\nits canonical block in `data-chart`, which the builder (T17) edits and\napp.markdown_form saves. A Chart that is invalid, or inside another block,\nis locked.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app import chart_drawing, charts\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, is_link, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\nfrom app.site_links import REFERENCE, TABLES\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return is_link(str(token.attrGet(\"href\"))) and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _chart(source: str) -> charts.Chart | None:\n    try:\n        return charts.parse(source)\n    except charts.ChartError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if len(block) == 1 and charts.is_chart(block[0]):\n        return _chart(block[0].content) is not None\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _site_link(href: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Editor shows a site link as the site reference it is, resolved or\n    not, so that it posts it back as it is and marks one that won't resolve.\"\"\"\n    return href if REFERENCE.fullmatch(href) else None\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = (render_markdown(locked[number], image_src, _site_link)\n             if number < len(locked) else \"\")\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\nCARD = \"admin-editor-chart\"\n\n\ndef _card_html(chart: charts.Chart, key: str, number: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Chart as the Editor shows it: its drawing, and its canonical block,\n    which is what the Editor posts back. Put in after nh3, like the site's\n    Charts: the drawing is safe as app.chart_drawing builds it, and the block\n    is escaped here; on save it is parsed again, never trusted.\"\"\"\n    return (f'<div class=\"{CARD}\" data-chart=\"{escape(chart.canonical())}\">'\n            f'{chart_drawing.draw(chart, key, number)}</div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`, and each valid top-level Chart as a card.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token and card is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows,\n    # so that nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    # (first line, line after the last, placeholder), each on its own.\n    spans = [(start, end, f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}\")\n             for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown)]\n    cards: list[charts.Chart] = []\n    for token in parse(markdown):\n        if (token.level == 0 and token.map and charts.is_chart(token)\n                and (chart := _chart(token.content))):\n            spans.append((*token.map, f\"chart-{nonce}-{len(cards)}\"))\n            cards.append(chart)\n    for start, end, placeholder in sorted(spans, reverse=True):\n        # A blank line either side, so a placeholder is its own paragraph\n        # (a fence may follow a paragraph's line straight on).\n        lines[start:end] = [\"\\n\", placeholder + _ending(lines[end - 1]), \"\\n\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src, _site_link))\n    # The cards' titles' ids need only be unique on the admin page.\n    key = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    return Markup(re.sub(\n        rf\"<p>(locked|chart)-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n        lambda m: (_locked_html(int(m[2]), locked, image_src) if m[1] == \"locked\"\n                   else _card_html(cards[int(m[2])], key, int(m[2]))), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, each locked block's token, and each\n# card's Chart.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"td\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"div\": {\"data-locked\", \"data-chart\"}}\n\n\n# A posted link's schemes, site links' included; app.markdown_form keeps\n# only the links the Editor may have (is_link).\n_POSTED_SCHEMES = {\"https\", \"mailto\", *TABLES}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None,\n                     url_schemes=_POSTED_SCHEMES)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\ndef canonical_charts(markdown: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each top-level Chart in it in canonical form (spec\n    #14), with the line endings of the line that closes it. A Chart that\n    breaks a rule is left as it is, for app.content.validate to name.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for token in reversed(parse(markdown)):\n        if not (charts.is_chart(token) and token.level == 0 and token.map):\n            continue\n        try:\n            chart = charts.parse(token.content)\n        except charts.ChartError:\n            continue\n        start, end = token.map\n        ending = _ending(lines[end - 1])\n        fence = f\"```{charts.INFO}\\n{chart.canonical()}```\\n\"\n        lines[start:end] = [fence.replace(\"\\n\", ending)]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return canonical_charts(self.body)\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. below a Subsection.\n  const HEADINGS = {H1: \"h2\", H2: \"h2\", H3: \"h3\", H4: \"h3\", H5: \"h3\", H6: \"h3\"};\n  const SKIPPED = new Set([\"SCRIPT\", \"STYLE\", \"TEMPLATE\", \"HEAD\", \"TITLE\", As the writer types, the\n  // server checks the Chart and draws it (app.routes.charts), with the\n  // drawing the public page has; each of its errors shows by its field or\n  // cell, and Insert waits until there are none. The dialog is outside the\n  // form, so nothing in it is posted with the item.\n\n  const CHART_TYPES = [[\"bar\", \"Vertical bar\"], [\"hbar\", \"Horizontal bar\"], [\"line\", \"Line\"]];\n  // The grammar's limits (app.charts), for the grid's buttons and pastes.\n  const MOST_CATEGORIES = {bar: 30, hbar: 30, line: 60};\n  const MOST_SERIES = 4;\n  const PASTE_CUT = \"The paste was larger than a chart can be, so its last rows or columns were left out.\";\n  const NOT_DRAWN = \"The chart can't be drawn right now. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n  // What reads as a value cell (app.charts.read_cell, roughly): for a\n  // paste, telling names from numbers. The server decides what is valid.\n  const MISSING_VALUES = new Set([\"\", \"—\", \"n/a\"]);\n  const SUPPRESSED = /^(\\*|(<|≤|<=)\\d+)$/;\n  const NUMBER = /^[-+]?\\(?\\$?(\\d{1,3}(,\\d{3})+|\\d+)(\\.\\d+)?%?\\)?( \\p{L}+([ -]\\p{L}+)*)?$/u;\n  let builders = 0;\n\n  function isValue(text) {\n    const typed = text.trim();\n    return MISSING_VALUES.has(typed.toLowerCase()) || SUPPRESSED.test(typed) || NUMBER.test(typed);\n  }\n\n  function chartBuilder(previewPath, csrfToken) {\n    const id = `admin-chart-builder-${++builders}`;\n    const field = (name, label, extra = \"\") => `\n      <p><label>${label} <input type=\"text\" data-field=\"${name}\" autocomplete=\"off\"\n        aria-describedby=\"${id}-${name}-error${extra ? ` ${id}-${name}-hint` : \"\"}\"></label>\n        ${extra ? `<small id=\"${id}-${name}-hint\">${extra}</small>` : \"\"}\n        <small class=\"admin-chart-builder-error\" id=\"${id}-${name}-error\" data-error-for=\"${name}\"></small></p>`;\n    const dialog = element(\"dialog\", {class: \"admin-chart-builder\", \"aria-labelledby\": `${id}-heading`});\n    dialog.innerHTML = `\n      <h2 id=\"${id}-heading\">Insert chart</h2>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-message\" role=\"alert\"></p>\n      <div class=\"admin-chart-builder-fields\">\n        <p><label>Type <select data-field=\"type\" aria-describedby=\"${id}-type-error\">\n          ${CHART_TYPES.map(([value, name]) => `<option value=\"${value}\">${name}</option>`).join(\"\")}\n        </select></label>\n          <small class=\"admin-chart-builder-error\" id=\"${id}-type-error\" data-error-for=\"type\"></small></p>\n        <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-suggestion\" hidden>Long category names are shortened under\n          vertical bars; a horizontal bar chart shows them whole.\n          <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"hbar\">Use horizontal bar</button></p>\n        ${field(\"title\", \"Title (required)\")}\n        ${field(\"x_label\", \"Category axis label\")}\n        ${field(\"y_label\", \"Value axis label\")}\n        ${field(\"unit\", \"Units\", \"$ goes before the numbers; %, or a word such as students, after.\")}\n        ${field(\"source\", \"Source or note\")}\n      </div>\n      <h3>Data</h3>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-hint\" id=\"${id}-grid-hint\">Categories down, series across.\n        Paste a range from Excel or Sheets into any cell; its top-left cell, if it names the\n        categories, becomes the category axis label. Empty rows and series at the end are left out.</p>\n      <div class=\"admin-chart-builder-grid-scroll\">\n        <table class=\"admin-chart-builder-grid\" aria-describedby=\"${id}-grid-hint\"></table>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-grid-tools\">\n        <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"add-category\">Add category</button>\n        <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"add-series\">Add series</button></p>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-error\" data-error-for=\"categories\"></p>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-error\" data-error-for=\"series\"></p>\n      <h3>Chart</h3>\n      <div class=\"content-body admin-chart-builder-preview\"></div>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-actions\">\n        <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"insert\" disabled>Insert chart</button>\n        <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"cancel\">Cancel</button>\n        <small class=\"admin-chart-builder-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>`;\n    document.body.append(dialog);\n    const heading = dialog.querySelector(\"h2\");\n    const messageLine = dialog.querySelector(\".admin-chart-builder-message\");\n    const suggestion = dialog.querySelector(\".admin-chart-builder-suggestion\");\n    const grid = dialog.querySelector(\".admin-chart-builder-grid\");\n    const preview = dialog.querySelector(\".admin-chart-builder-preview\");\n    const insertButton = dialog.querySelector(\"[data-builder=insert]\");\n    const statusLine = dialog.querySelector(\".admin-chart-builder-status\");\n\n    // The Chart as the dialog holds it: every field as typed, and the grid's\n    // rows and columns, empty ones too.\n    let state = null;\n    // The fields whose errors show: those typed in, left, or pasted into;\n    // every one when editing a Chart.\n    let touched = new Set();\n    let showAll = false;\n    // The server's answer for the dialog as it is now, once it has come.\n    let answer = null;\n    let pending = false;\n    let timer = null;\n    let latest = 0;\n    let onInsert = null;\n    // Said once after a paste the grid couldn't hold all of.\n    let pasteNote = \"\";\n\n    function open(text, inserted) {\n      const chart = text ? parseJson(text, null) : null;\n      state = chart ? fromChart(chart) : blankChart();\n      touched = new Set();\n      showAll = Boolean(chart);\n      onInsert = inserted;\n      answer = null;\n      pending = true;\n      pasteNote = \"\";\n      heading.textContent = chart ? \"Edit chart\" : \"Insert chart\";\n      insertButton.textContent = chart ? \"Update chart\" : \"Insert chart\";\n      for (const input of dialog.querySelectorAll(\".admin-chart-builder-fields [data-field]\")) {\n        input.value = state[input.dataset.field];\n      }\n      preview.replaceChildren();\n      renderGrid();\n      dialog.showModal();\n      dialog.querySelector(\"[data-field=title]\").focus();\n      redraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function blankChart() {\n      return {type: \"bar\", title: \"\", x_label: \"\", y_label: \"\", unit: \"\", source: \"\",\n              categories: [\"\", \"\", \"\"], series: [{name: \"Series 1\", values: [\"\", \"\", \"\"]}]};\n    }\n\n    }\n  }\n\n  function nextElement(node) {\n    let sibling = node.nextSibling;\n    while (sibling && sibling.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) sibling = sibling.nextSibling;\n    return sibling;\n  }\n\n  function textAsHtml(text) {\n    return text.split(/\\r?\\n\\s*\\r?\\n/).map((paragraph) =>\n      `<p>${escapeHtml(paragraph.trim()).replace(/\\r?\\n/g, \"<br>\")}</p>`).join(\"\");\n  }\n\n  function validUrl(href) {\n    try {\n      new URL(href);\n      return true;\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function parseJson(text, fallback) {\n    try {\n      return text ? JSON.parse(text) : fallback;\n    } catch {\n      return fallback;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function hasFiles(transfer) {\n    return Boolean(transfer) && [...transfer.types].includes(\"Files\");\n  }\n\n  function hidden(form, name) {\n    const input = element(\"input\", {type: \"hidden\", name});\n    form.append(input);\n    return input;\n  }\n\n  function element(tag, attributes = {}, children = []) {\n    const node = document.createElement(tag);\n    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) node.setAttribute(name, value);\n    node.append(...children);\n    return node;\n  }\n\n  function escapeHtml(text) {\n    return text.replace(/[&<>\"']/g, (c) => `&#${c.charCodeAt(0)};`);\n  }\n})();\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Data Bites</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if bites %}\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Slug</th><th>Status</th><th>Author</th><th>Updated</th><th></th></tr></thead>\n     assert stored(rid) == [\"keep.png\"], rid\n\n\ndef test_once_published_an_analysts_upload_and_delete_are_rejected(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n {"parentUuid":"e4ca9cfe-59c2-4b96-94f9-441ff57f3afb","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4dc5332e-fccd-45f6-b53b-fb048524d43a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013ckKbJywoJS5t99gnkePDg","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T12: Site preview (issue #15).\n\nA Data Bite's or Report's Site preview is its public page, rendered by the\npublic templates as if it were published, with the form's unsaved edits and a\n\"Draft preview, not published\" banner. It is served under the item's admin\npath (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/preview/), which is the preview's own copy of\nthe site: its links stay relative, as the export's, and a <base> places the\npage at its path in that copy.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report, report_id\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import PDF, pdf, post_with_file\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import PAYLOAD, assert_inert\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import site_preview_page as framed\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import (DRAFT_LEAKS, a_site_with_drafts, crawl, nav,\n                                        published_bite, published_report)\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, img_tags, png\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import upload as upload_to_bite\nfrom tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\n\nBANNER = \"Draft preview, not published\"\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, published_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, published_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef preview(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str | None = None, *, with_csrf=True, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form (or, with no item, the create form) to its Site preview.\"\"\"\n    path = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview\" if item_id else f\"/admin/{kind}/preview\"\n    return post_form(c, path, form, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef base_of(page: str) -> str:\n    [base] = re.findall(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\">', page)\n    return base\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every href and src on the page but its <base>'s.\"\"\"\n    return [link for tag, link in re.findall(r'<(\\w+)[^>]*?(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', page)\n            if tag != \"base\"]\n\n\ndef without_preview_marks(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The page without its banner and <base>: what the export would write.\"\"\"\n    page = re.sub(r'\\s*<base href=\"[^\"]*\">', \"\", page)\n    return re.sub(r'\\s*<p class=\"site-preview-banner\"[^>]*>[^<]*</p>', \"\", page)\n\n\ndef stored_row(kind: str, item_id: str):\n    return (data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports).get(int(item_id))\n\n\n# The public page, as if published\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, publish\", KINDS)\n\"\"\"T11: Chart images on Reports (issue #13).\n\nThe checks on an upload itself (formats, size, count, names) are T10's shared\ncode, tested there; here, what a Report adds: the lockdown, the Report's\npages and export, and independence from its attached PDF.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import reports, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import PDF, pdf, post_with_file, reports_file\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import crawl, published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import body_of, preview_of\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, WEBP, img_attributes, img_tags, png, png_bytes\n\nPNG = png()[1]\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, rid: str, file, *, with_csrf=True):\n    return post_with_file(c, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images\", {}, file, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef delete_image(c: TestClient, rid: str, name: str, *, with_csrf=True):\n    return post_form(c, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/{name}/delete\", {}, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef stored(rid: str) -> list[str]:\n    folder = settings.UPLOADS / \"images\" / \"reports\" / rid\n    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir()) if folder.exists() else []\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, rid: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\n        def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n            if tag == \"img\":\n                found.append(dict(attrs))\n\n    Parser().feed(html)\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_the_preview_shows_the_draft_image_from_its_preview_site(client_as, client):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst, body=CHART)\n    upload(analyst, bid, png())\n\n    # As the published page will (T12): relative, under the preview's <base>.\n    expected = '<img src=\"../images/data-bites/fall-enrollment/fall-by-class.png\" alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">'\n analyst.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/preview/images/data-bites/fall-enrollment/fall-by-class.png\")\n    assert served.status_code == 200 and served.content == PNG\n    assert client.get(\"/images/data-bites/fall-enrollment/fall-by-class.png\").status_code == 404\n    # The edit page's first render, and its live preview posts to the item's own preview.\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\").text\n    assert img_tags(preview_of(page)) == [expected]\n    assert f'\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/preview\"' in {"parentUuid":"047bdfc6-0664-40d1-b347-a3c0b9097301","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbnDhdanYrRZt7zv4YpM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LpSFjKpJyVAFyCTFwjD2nZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t18_editor_images.py","content":"\"\"\"T18: Chart images in the Editor (issue #21).\n\nThe Editor's \"Insert image\" lists the item's Chart images, from the edit\npage, and puts one in the body with a description; the server reads it back\nas `![Description](image:<name>)` (app.markdown_form), as T10/T11 store it.\nWhat the Editor does in the browser is checked by hand (the closing comment);\nhere, what the server gives it and what a post of its HTML saves.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, img_tags, png\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import upload as upload_to_bite\nfrom tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\nfrom tests.test_t12_site_preview import preview\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import edit_page, editor_content, save, stored\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, upload_to_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, upload_to_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef body_images(page: str) -> list[dict] | None:\n    \"\"\"The Chart images the page's Editor may insert; None if it is given\n    none to list, as on a create page.\"\"\"\n    found = re.findall(r\"\"\"<div class=\"admin-editor\"[^>]*? data-images='([^']*)'\"\"\", page)\n    return json.loads(unescape(found[0])) if found else None\n\n\ndef img(kind: str, item_id: str, name: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A chart image as the Editor shows and posts it: from the admin route.\"\"\"\n    return f'<img src=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/{name}\" alt=\"{alt}\">'\n\n\ndef module_for(kind: str):\n    from app import data_bites, reports\n    return data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef analyst(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n# What the Editor is given.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_edit_page_gives_the_editor_its_chart_images_by_name_and_admin_src(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    assert body_images(edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)) == []\n\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png(\"spring.png\"))\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png(\"fall-by-class.png\"))\n    images = body_images(edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id))\n    assert images == [\n        {\"name\": \"fall-by-class.png\", \"src\": f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/fall-by-class.png\"},\n        {\"name\": \"spring.png\", \"src\": f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/spring.png\"}]\n    # Each src is the thumbnail the Editor shows, served to a signed-in user.\n    assert analyst.get(images[0][\"src\"]).content == png()[1]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_create_page_gives_the_editor_no_images_to_list(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text\n    assert 'class=\"admin-editor\"' in page\n    assert body_images(page) is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_copy_a_snippet_list_is_gone_but_each_image_can_still_be_deleted(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    section = page[page.index('<section class=\"content-images\"'):]\n    assert \"![Description](image:\" not in page\n    assert \"fall-by-class.png\" in section\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/fall-by-class.png/delete\"' in section\n    assert \"Insert image\" in section\n\n\n# What an insert, a change, or a removal saves.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_inserted_image_is_stored_as_its_image_reference(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst, body=\"Enrollment by class:\")\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n\n    # As the Editor places it: a paragraph of its own after the cursor's.\n    html = (editor_content(page)\n            + f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")}</p>'\n            + \"<p>Source: IR.</p>\")\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == (\n        \"Enrollment by class:\\n\\n![Fall enrollment by class](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\\n\"\n        \"Source: IR.\\n\")\n    # And the Editor shows it again from its admin route, with its description.\n    assert img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\") in editor_content(\n        edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id))\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_description_with_markdown_characters_is_kept_as_typed(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    alt = \"Fall [2025] enrollment *by* class &amp; year\"\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", alt)}</p>'\n    save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\")\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    assert img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", alt) in editor_content(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_changing_a_description_or_removing_an_image_changes_only_that(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst, body=CHART)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    shown = editor_content(page)\n    old = img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")\n    assert old in shown\n\n    changed = shown.replace(old, img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Students by class, fall 2026\"))\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=changed, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == (\n        \"Enrollment by class:\\n\\n![Students by class, fall 2026](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\")\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    removed = re.sub(r\"<p><img [^>]*></p>\", \"\", editor_content(page))\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=removed, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"Enrollment by class:\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_image_from_anywhere_else_is_left_out(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    other = create(analyst, slug=\"other-item\")\n    upload(analyst, other, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = (f'<p>Before {img(kind, other, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Another item\")}'\n            '<img src=\"https://example.test/chart.png\" alt=\"Hot-linked\"> after</p>')\n    save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\")\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"Before after\\n\"\n\n\n# The description: required in the Editor, only warned of by the server.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_image_with_no_description_saves_and_is_warned_of(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"\")}</p>'\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"![](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\"\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    warning = re.search(r'<p class=\"content-image-warning\"[^>]*>(.*?)</p>', page, re.S)\n    assert warning and \"fall-by-class.png\" in warning[1]\n    # It tells the writer how to fix it in the Editor, not in Markdown.\n    assert \"![\" not in warning[1]\n\n\n# The Site preview.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_inserted_image_shows_in_the_site_preview_before_it_is_saved(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")}</p>'\n    shown = preview(analyst, kind, item_id, title=\"Fall\", body=\"\", body_html=html,\n                    body_dirty=\"1\", item_base=re.search(r'name=\"item_base\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1])\n    assert shown.status_code == 200\n    [tag] = img_tags(shown.text)\n    assert re.fullmatch(r'<img src=\"\\.\\./images/[a-z-]+/[a-z-]+/fall-by-class\\.png\" '\n                        r'alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">', tag), tag\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] != \"![Fall enrollment by class](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\"\n    assert csrf_from(page)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1964,"cache_read_input_tokens":119180,"output_tokens":3728,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1964,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3728,"cache_read_input_tokens":119180,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1964,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1964},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01LpSFjKpJyVAFyCTFwjD2nZ":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t18_editor_images.py","content":"\"\"\"T18: back)"}]},"uuid":"7c94e7d8-021a-4dd8-b7d9-8db18fbc0ccb","timestamp":"2026-10-01T15:49:05.011Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t18_editor_images.py","content":"\"\"\"T18: Chart images in the Editor (issue #21).\n\nThe Editor's \"Insert image\" lists the item's Chart images, from the edit\npage, and puts one in the body with a description; the server reads it back\nas `![Description](image:<name>)` (app.markdown_form), as T10/T11 store it.\nWhat the Editor does in the browser is checked by hand (the closing comment);\nhere, what the server gives it and what a post of its HTML saves.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, img_tags, png\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import upload as upload_to_bite\nfrom tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\nfrom tests.test_t12_site_preview import preview\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import edit_page, editor_content, save, stored\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, upload_to_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, upload_to_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef body_images(page: str) -> list[dict] | None:\n    \"\"\"The Chart images the page's Editor may insert; None if it is given\n    none to list, as on a create page.\"\"\"\n    found = re.findall(r\"\"\"<div class=\"admin-editor\"[^>]*? data-images='([^']*)'\"\"\", page)\n    return json.loads(unescape(found[0])) if found else None\n\n\ndef img(kind: str, item_id: str, name: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A chart image as the Editor shows and posts it: from the admin route.\"\"\"\n    return f'<img src=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/{name}\" alt=\"{alt}\">'\n\n\ndef module_for(kind: str):\n    from app import data_bites, reports\n    return data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef analyst(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n# What the Editor is given.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_edit_page_gives_the_editor_its_chart_images_by_name_and_admin_src(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    assert body_images(edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)) == []\n\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png(\"spring.png\"))\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png(\"fall-by-class.png\"))\n    images = body_images(edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id))\n    assert images == [\n        {\"name\": \"fall-by-class.png\", \"src\": f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/fall-by-class.png\"},\n        {\"name\": \"spring.png\", \"src\": f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/spring.png\"}]\n    # Each src is the thumbnail the Editor shows, served to a signed-in user.\n    assert analyst.get(images[0][\"src\"]).content == png()[1]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_create_page_gives_the_editor_no_images_to_list(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text\n    assert 'class=\"admin-editor\"' in page\n    assert body_images(page) is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_copy_a_snippet_list_is_gone_but_each_image_can_still_be_deleted(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    section = page[page.index('<section class=\"content-images\"'):]\n    assert \"![Description](image:\" not in page\n    assert \"fall-by-class.png\" in section\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/images/fall-by-class.png/delete\"' in section\n    assert \"Insert image\" in section\n\n\n# What an insert, a change, or a removal saves.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_inserted_image_is_stored_as_its_image_reference(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst, body=\"Enrollment by class:\")\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n\n    # As the Editor places it: a paragraph of its own after the cursor's.\n    html = (editor_content(page)\n            + f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")}</p>'\n            + \"<p>Source: IR.</p>\")\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == (\n        \"Enrollment by class:\\n\\n![Fall enrollment by class](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\\n\"\n        \"Source: IR.\\n\")\n    # And the Editor shows it again from its admin route, with its description.\n    assert img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\") in editor_content(\n        edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id))\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_description_with_markdown_characters_is_kept_as_typed(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    alt = \"Fall [2025] enrollment *by* class &amp; year\"\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", alt)}</p>'\n    save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\")\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    assert img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", alt) in editor_content(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_changing_a_description_or_removing_an_image_changes_only_that(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst, body=CHART)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    shown = editor_content(page)\n    old = img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")\n    assert old in shown\n\n    changed = shown.replace(old, img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Students by class, fall 2026\"))\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=changed, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == (\n        \"Enrollment by class:\\n\\n![Students by class, fall 2026](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\")\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    removed = re.sub(r\"<p><img [^>]*></p>\", \"\", editor_content(page))\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=removed, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"Enrollment by class:\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_image_from_anywhere_else_is_left_out(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    other = create(analyst, slug=\"other-item\")\n    upload(analyst, other, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = (f'<p>Before {img(kind, other, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Another item\")}'\n            '<img src=\"https://example.test/chart.png\" alt=\"Hot-linked\"> after</p>')\n    save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\")\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"Before after\\n\"\n\n\n# The description: required in the Editor, only warned of by the server.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_image_with_no_description_saves_and_is_warned_of(analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"\")}</p>'\n    assert save(analyst, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] == \"![](image:fall-by-class.png)\\n\"\n\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    warning = re.search(r'<p class=\"content-image-warning\"[^>]*>(.*?)</p>', page, re.S)\n    assert warning and \"fall-by-class.png\" in warning[1]\n    # It tells the writer how to fix it in the Editor, not in Markdown.\n    assert \"![\" not in warning[1]\n\n\n# The Site preview.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, upload\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_inserted_image_shows_in_the_site_preview_before_it_is_saved(\n        analyst, kind, create, upload):\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, item_id, png())\n    page = edit_page(analyst, kind, item_id)\n    html = f'<p>{img(kind, item_id, \"fall-by-class.png\", \"Fall enrollment by class\")}</p>'\n    shown = preview(analyst, kind, item_id, title=\"Fall\", body=\"\", body_html=html,\n                    body_dirty=\"1\", item_base=re.search(r'name=\"item_base\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1])\n    assert shown.status_code == 200\n    [tag] = img_tags(shown.text)\n    assert re.fullmatch(r'<img src=\"\\.\\./images/[a-z-]+/[a-z-]+/fall-by-class\\.png\" '\n                        r'alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">', tag), tag\n    assert stored(module_for(kind), item_id)[\"body\"] != \"![Fall
